note: A one-day meeting at the Royal Society in London, organised by Ben Green and Jon Keating, that brought together leading mathematicians, early-career researchers and representatives of relevant organisations to explore the implications of AI for mathematics, with talks and panel discussions. It was free to attend, in person and online, and was livestreamed.
title: Mathematics in the age of AI
who: The Royal Society; organised by Ben Green (Oxford) and Jon Keating (Oxford)
